energy.statement:
Let $G$ be an abelian group (written additively). For a natural number $n$, a finite set $s \subseteq G$ and a function $
u : G 	o \mathbb{C}$, $\mathrm{energy}_n(s, 
u)$ is the real number $\mathrm{energy}_n(s,
u) = \sum_{\gamma \in s^n} \sum_{\delta \in s^n} \left| 
u\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n} \gamma_i - \sum_{i=1}^{n} \delta_iight) ight|$, where $s^n$ denotes the set of $n$-tuples $(\gamma_1, \dots, \gamma_n)$ with every $\gamma_i \in s$.

boringEnergy.statement:
Let $G$ be an abelian group (written additively). For a natural number $n$ and a finite set $s \subseteq G$, $\mathrm{boringEnergy}_n(s) = \mathrm{energy}_n(s, \mathrm{trivChar})$, where $\mathrm{energy}_n(s,
u) = \sum_{\gamma, \delta \in s^n} |
u(\sum_{i} \gamma_i - \sum_i \delta_i)|$ for $
u : G 	o \mathbb{C}$ (with $s^n$ the set of $n$-tuples of elements of $s$) and $\mathrm{trivChar} : G 	o \mathbb{C}$ is $1$ at $0$ and $0$ elsewhere. Equivalently, $\mathrm{boringEnergy}_n(s)$ is the number of pairs $(\gamma, \delta) \in s^n 	imes s^n$ with $\sum_{i=1}^n \gamma_i = \sum_{i=1}^n \delta_i$, as a real number.
